enforce_zdr_anthropic.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for Anthropic models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.

enforce_zdr_google.description: Whether to enforce zero data retention for Google models. Falls back to enforce_zdr when not provided.
